mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `farm` f WHERE 1 = 1 AND f.user_id = #{userId}) AS farms, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `plot` p WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.user_id = #{userId}) AS plots, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `planting_batch` pb WHERE 1 = 1 AND pb.user_id = #{userId}) AS batches, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `iot_device` d WHERE 1 = 1 AND d.user_id = #{userId}) AS devices, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `iot_device_fault` f INNER JOIN `iot_device` d ON d.id = f.device_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND d.user_id = #{userId}) AS faults
mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.online_status = 1 AND d.health_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.control_status = 1 AND d.online_status = 1 AND d.health_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE () * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END, 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT 'sensorOnline' AS metric_key, '传感器在线' AS label, COUNT(1) AS total_count, AS online_count, AS active_count, AS online_rate FROM `iot_device` d LEFT JOIN `device_type` dt ON dt.id = d.type_id WHERE ( UPPER(COALESCE(dt.type_code, '')) IN ('ENV_SENSOR', 'WATER_QUALITY', 'NUTRIENT_SENSOR', 'NUTRITION_SENSOR', 'NUTRITION_DETECTOR') OR dt.type_name LIKE '%环境%' OR dt.type_name LIKE '%水质%' OR dt.type_name LIKE '%营养%' OR d.name LIKE '%环境%' OR d.name LIKE '%水质%' OR d.name LIKE '%营养%' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pumpRunning' AS metric_key, '水泵运行' AS label, COUNT(1) AS total_count, AS online_count, AS active_count, AS online_rate FROM `iot_device` d LEFT JOIN `device_type` dt ON dt.id = d.type_id WHERE ( UPPER(COALESCE(dt.type_code, '')) = 'WATER_PUMP' OR dt.type_name LIKE '%水泵%' OR d.name LIKE '%水泵%' OR d.name LIKE '%泵%' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lightRunning' AS metric_key, '补光灯照明' AS label, COUNT(1) AS total_count, AS online_count, AS active_count, AS online_rate FROM `iot_device` d LEFT JOIN `device_type` dt ON dt.id = d.type_id WHERE ( UPPER(COALESCE(dt.type_code, '')) = 'GROW_LIGHT' OR dt.type_name LIKE '%补光%' OR dt.type_name LIKE '%灯%' OR d.name LIKE '%补光%' OR d.name LIKE '%灯%' )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fanRunning' AS metric_key, '风机运行' AS label, COUNT(1) AS total_count, AS online_count, AS active_count, AS online_rate FROM `iot_device` d LEFT JOIN `device_type` dt ON dt.id = d.type_id WHERE ( UPPER(COALESCE(dt.type_code, '')) = 'FAN' OR LOWER(COALESCE(dt.type_code, '')) LIKE '%fan%' OR dt.type_name LIKE '%风机%' OR d.name LIKE '%风机%' OR LOWER(d.name) LIKE '%fan%' )

SELECT 'realtimeMonitoring' AS metric_key, '实时监测' AS label, COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.online_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS online_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.online_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_count, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.online_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END, 1 ) AS online_rate FROM `camera_device` c LEFT JOIN `plot` p ON p.id = c.plot_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT wi.category, CASE wi.category WHEN 1 THEN '种子' WHEN 2 THEN '肥料' WHEN 3 THEN '农药' WHEN 4 THEN '工具' WHEN 5 THEN '设备耗材' ELSE '其他' END AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(wi.stock_qty * iir.price), 2) AS total_value FROM `warehouse_item` wi JOIN `warehouse_record` iir ON iir.id = ( SELECT wr.id FROM `warehouse_record` wr WHERE wr.item_id = wi.id AND wr.record_type = 1 AND wr.status = 1 ORDER BY wr.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE wi.is_deleted = 0 AND wi.stock_qty > 0 AND iir.price > 0
AND wi.farm_owner_id = #{userId} GROUP BY wi.category ORDER BY wi.category

SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(ref_id, id)) COUNT(1)
FROM `notification` WHERE status = 1 AND is_read = 0
AND notice_type = 1 AND ref_type = 'system_announcement'
AND user_id = #{userId}
